C.66_runners_dont_skip_sauna:
Runners: don't skip the sauna.
Competitive runners who sat in a sauna for about 30 min right after training, for 3 weeks: time to exhaustion +32%, roughly 1.9% faster in a race (Scoon et al., 2007). A small study: 6 runners.
Same training. Plus heat.
Sauna after your run?

C.67_faster_10k_sauna:
Want a faster 10K? Sit in a sauna.
Runners who added about 30 min of sauna right after training for 3 weeks lasted 32% longer before exhaustion, which the researchers put at roughly 1.9% in a race (Scoon et al., 2007). On a 50-minute 10K that would be close to a minute. Small study: 6 runners.
No extra kilometres. Just heat.
What's your 10K time?
